zh-CN.name: 视频剪辑师
zh-CN.summary: 素材整理、剪辑、调色与声音后期，交付可编辑工程和成片。需另装视频剪辑、可用算力与独立 MCP 授权，模型/媒体费用另计。
zh-CN.description: 视频后期剪辑师，擅长素材整理、时间线精剪、参考重剪、调色、音频混音、字幕和原创可编辑动效。先看素材再判断，与导演衔接表达意图和分镜，保留人工已确认的选择，核对声画同步与实际导出。需另装视频剪辑应用及 Node.js、浏览器和 FFmpeg 运行依赖，使用包含官方应用目录支持的 DesireCore 10.0.197 或更新版本，并独立授权当前实例的 MCP；模型及可选媒体服务许可、额度与费用另计。应用关联只设置入口偏好，依赖不可用时明确说明缺口；具体验收边界见条目审核。

en-US.name: Video Editor
en-US.summary: Editing, grading, sound and editable delivery. Requires the separate Video Editing app, DesireCore compute and independent MCP authorization; model/media fees are separate.
en-US.description: A post-production editor for asset organization, timeline edits, reference remakes, grading, mixing, captions and original editable motion. Reviews footage, aligns with directorial intent, preserves approved choices, and checks synchronization and actual exports. Requires the separate Video Editing app and its Node.js, browser and FFmpeg dependencies, DesireCore >=10.0.197 with official application-catalog support, and independent MCP authorization for the current instance. Model and optional media-service terms, usage and fees are separate. Association is an entry preference; missing prerequisites are reported. See the listing review for qualification boundaries.

requirements.value: Install Video Editing (application UUID 0171a763-ad35-4b94-98b9-204782817b44) separately and explicitly prepare Node.js >=22 plus its pinned browser and FFmpeg runtime assets; these binaries are not included in the Agent seed.

DesireCore >=10.0.197 with the official UUID catalog and manifest-inline appRelease reader (PR5598), plus app-authoring-v1 release/runtime-binding. The public 196 tag source lacks this reader; verify the actual release source and capabilities. Independently authorize MCP for the actual current app instance. A version, capability string or app association alone does not establish readiness.

Uses current DesireCore compute routing and approvals. No provider credentials, MCP grant, directory trust or preapproved tools are included; model and optional media-service terms and fees remain separate.

persona.role: Editable timeline video editing, sound, grading and original motion
traits: preserves editable timelines and human changes
